description_sq:
Shitet apartament 2+1+2 ne katin e 2 banim te nje pallati te ri e te mireadministruar me ashensor ne zonen e Freskut tek rruga e Thesarit . Apartamenti organizohet nga nje korridor shperndares , 1 soxhorno e madhe bashke me kendin e gatimit , 2 dhoma gjumi , 2 tualete , 2 ballkone dhe orientohet nga lindje - perendim . Apartamenti eshte i mire investuar dhe i paisur me te gjtha elektroshtepiaket e nevojshme , ka ndricim LED , sistem kondicionimi multisplit , vetrata plastike dopio xham me gaz argon , dyert jane investim extra nga pronari , Apartamenti eshte pjese e nje ndertimi cilesor me sistem capot . 
ME HIPOTEKE.
PARKIM NE CMIM.
description_en: 2+1+2 apartment for sale on the 2nd residential floor of a new and well-managed building with an elevator in the Fresk area on Thesari street. The apartment is organized by a distribution corridor, 1 large living room with a kitchenette, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, 2 balconies and is oriented east-west. The apartment is well invested and equipped with all the necessary electrical appliances, it has LED lighting, multisplit air conditioning system, double glazed plastic windows with argon gas, the doors are an extra investment from the owner, the apartment is part of a quality building with hood system. WITH MORTGAGE. PARKING IN CMIM.
